propositions: Three independent detached-child spawn implementations in push.py, enrich_drain.py, and compact_trigger.py duplicate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, and cwd handling; a defect in one propagates identically to all three
A single consolidated spawn_detached() helper in _proc.py must own PYTHONPATH bootstrap, platform detach flags, and durable cwd anchoring while remaining a stdlib-only leaf and re-raising on failure
Each call site retains its own exception handling, env construction (push.py's secret-stripped projection + REBAR_SYNC_PUSH versus drain/sweep's plain environ), and logging posture

A static source-scan test must enforce that detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry stub) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste duplication

The cwd fallback in _config_sources.repo_root must maintain its raising posture on Path.cwd() failure; detached children anchor to durable cwd via spawn_detached, and long-lived in-process work must pass explicit root or REBAR_ROOT
